publisher_reported.basis: institutional project description; newer 2023 edition linked; not measured

definitions.dedup: Exact NFC/case/apostrophe-normalized token sequences, lexical and text roles separate. Dedup independently within each reported scope; category/source dedup totals need not add to global dedup.
definitions.sentences: Heuristic punctuation units for prose; UI fragments and lexical forms have zero sentence units. Not linguistically certified segmentation.
definitions.pages: PDF page or current MediaWiki page ID; zero means no page representation, not zero documents.
definitions.eligibility: Conditional intersection includes license obligations; not an unconditional training grant. Model distribution remains separately assessed.
definitions.review: All records screened, only explicit hashed decisions contextually reviewed. Rule silence never verifies.
definitions.liita_overlap: Treebank sentence equality after rejoining apostrophe clitics is measured separately. All ten documented RDF reproductions of existing UD documents are excluded from novel totals by provenance, including punctuation/segmentation differences. Lexical overlap conservatively matches single-word UD surface vocabulary. Similarity alone does not delete text.
definitions.wiki: Main-namespace nonredirect static article body; no rendered templates, tables, media captions or references. 2023 snapshot is a separate source, not current revisions.
